description_en: This API recognizes structured fields from both the front and back of a second-generation Chinese resident identity card. These fields include name, gender, ethnicity, address, date of birth, ID number, issuing authority, and validity period. It also supports ID quality checks, such as detecting screen captures, photocopies, completeness scores, overall quality scores, tampering indexes, and face location detection
description_zh: 支持二代身份证正反面，包括姓名、性别、民族、地址、出生日期、身份证号、签发机关、有效期限等字段的结构化识别。支持身份证质量检测，是否翻拍，是否是复印件，完整度评分，整体质量分数、篡改指数及人脸位置检测
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-idcard --url https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB1q5IeXAvoK1RjSZFNXXcxMVXa-483-307.jpg --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --output-figure false --output-quality-info false --llm-rec true --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeIdcard

parameters.help_en:
Use either this parameter or the body parameter. You must specify one, but not both.

The URL of the image. The URL must be less than 2,048 bytes. Base64 encoding is not supported
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
Use either this parameter or the Url parameter. You must specify one, but not both.

The binary data of the image. The size cannot exceed 10 MB.

If you call the API over HTTP, place the image binary data in the HTTP request body.

If you use a software development kit (SDK), pass the image data in the \`body\` parameter of the SDK method
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable pattern detection. The default value is false.

true: enables pattern detection. false: disables pattern detection
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要图案检测功能，默认不需要。
true：需要；false：不需要
parameters.name: output_figure

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable ID quality checks. The default value is false.

Quality checks include detection for screen captures and photocopies, a completeness score, an overall quality score, and a tampering index.

Note: If you set this parameter, you must use the latest SDK version. If you do not set this parameter, you do not need to update the SDK
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要身份证质量检测功能，默认不需要。
身份证质量检测功能包含：是否翻拍，是否是复印件，完整度评分，整体质量分数、篡改指数。
注意：如果需要设置此参数，请使用最新版本SDK。如果不需要设置此参数，您无需更新SDK
parameters.name: output_quality_info

Code.description_en: The error code. This parameter is returned only when an error occurs
Code.description_zh: 错误码（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is returned only when an error occurs
Message.description_zh: 错误提示（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）
Message.example: You are not authorized to perform this operation.
